$comment: What an agent call of the dispatcher's must show in its init event on the pinned Claude Code (incident-platform backlog #0-301, ADR-0064 points 3 and 5, ADR-0065): the version, the builtin plugins and the builtin agents measured on it (F3, managed settings, 2026-11-22; the spike of #0-300 for the agents, web-fetch listed in some of its calls), and each agent's tools. Both builtin lists are measured with the whole of callEnv's variables (dispatcher/src/flow/call.mjs), CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 among them; the first call on the VM (#0-301 AC4) records those of its init event, and lists that differ are corrected before any run (until then a run stops at the init check, as it should). claudeCodeVersion is the one value incident-platform's check-factory-copies.rb compares with its .devcontainer/claude-code.pin (#0-301 AC6): MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, no v. Read by dispatcher/src/flow/expectations.mjs, checked by dispatcher/test/flow-units.test.mjs.
